info.name: Beat-X API Running
info.description:
Complete, step-by-step Postman collection for the Beat-X backend, organized by WHO calls the endpoint instead of by resource:

• **Auth** — public register/login/password-reset flows shared by every role.  
• **User** — everything a logged-in regular user can do, plus every public browsing endpoint (songs, albums, videos, podcasts, audiobooks, events, products, genres, categories).  
• **Artist** — verification onboarding + creator tools (create/update/delete your own songs, videos, podcasts, merch); events are now admin-created — request one via a Support Ticket and manage limited fields with the access code you're given.\\n• **Support Tickets** — artists reach admins through category-based tickets (e.g. Event Management) with a realtime, two-way message thread; admins triage tickets and, for event requests, create the event and hand back an access code.  
• **Admin** — full moderation & management: approve artists, manage taxonomy, moderate every content type, run the scheduler.

How to use:

1. Run **Auth** top-to-bottom once for the User role and once for the Artist role (register → verify email with the OTP from your server logs/email).
    
2. For Admin, register a normal account, then manually set its role to "admin" in MongoDB (no public admin-signup route exists).
    
3. Open **User**, **Artist**, and **Admin** and run each folder's own "Login" request first — it stores that role's token into its own collection variable (userAccessToken / artistAccessToken / adminAccessToken), so all three roles can stay logged in at the same time without overwriting each other.
    
4. Inside each resource folder, requests are ordered as a workflow (e.g. Create → List → Get → Update → Delete) and automatically capture the IDs they create into collection variables for you — just run them in order.
    

All collection variables (tokens + resource ids) auto-populate as you go; edit the credential variables at the top if you want different test accounts.

item.description:
Public account flows shared by every role: register, verify email (OTP), forgot/reset password, refresh, logout.

Admin accounts CANNOT self-register — there is no public endpoint for it. Register a normal user, verify it, then manually change that user's "role" field to "admin" in MongoDB. After that, use the Admin folder's own Login request.

Run requests in this folder top-to-bottom (numbered) once per role before moving on to the role folders below.
